name: Nook
description:
Your smart home from the top bar: lights, plugs, sensors, cameras, air conditioners, TVs and speakers.

Works with Home Assistant, Philips Hue, HomeKit, Smart Life (Tuya), Mi Home and eWeLink. On the local network it talks to Gree, Midea and Daikin air conditioners, Tapo cameras, Sonoff switches in DIY mode, Cast speakers and TVs from Samsung, LG, Sony, Panasonic, Philips, Roku, Android and Google TV, and Apple TV. LG ThinQ, SmartThings, MELCloud and Electrolux air conditioners come through their accounts. Pairing an Android TV needs the openssl command.

Clouds are asked when the menu opens, and every few minutes for readings shown in the top bar, never while the screen is locked. Nook stays on while the screen is locked only to turn leak and smoke alerts from a Xiaomi gateway on the local network into notifications.

In the settings, the copy button next to a donation address puts it on the clipboard; Nook reads nothing from it.
